title: Interior L² mollification error bounded by ε²∫‖Du‖²
statement: Let n ∈ ℕ, u : ℝⁿ → ℝ L-Lipschitz (ℝⁿ = Euclid n), and ρ : ℝⁿ → ℝ continuous with ρ ≥ 0, ρ(z) = 0 whenever ‖z‖ ≥ 1, and ∫ρ = 1. Let 0 < ε ≤ s and v(x) := ∫ u(x − εz)ρ(z) dz. Then ∫_{B̆_{1−s}(0)} (u(x) − v(x))² dx ≤ ε² ∫_{B̆_1(0)} ‖Du‖², where Du = fderiv ℝ u.
lean_statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (u ρ : Euclid n → ℝ) (L : NNReal) (ε s : ℝ), LipschitzWith L u → Continuous ρ → (∀ z, 0 ≤ ρ z) → (∀ z : Euclid n, 1 ≤ ‖z‖ → ρ z = 0) → ∫ z, ρ z = 1 → 0 < ε → ε ≤ s → ∫ x in ball (0 : Euclid n) (1 - s), (u x - ∫ z, u (x - ε • z) * ρ z) ^ 2 ≤ ε ^ 2 * ∫ x in ball (0 : Euclid n) 1, ‖fderiv ℝ u x‖ ^ 2
